verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents official SDKs for browser, iOS, Android, Node.js and other platforms, used to instrument apps, sites and backends, plus an HTTP Tracking API with a batch endpoint. A published OpenAPI 3.0 spec for the REST API also lets developers generate clients for syncs, models, sources and destinations. missing for 10: an official SDK or client library for the management REST API (the documented SDKs cover event collection only), in-depth SDK reference evidence beyond the listing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
